geometry.canvas_offset_source: measured from zero against the canonical render + ink-prediction alignment
geometry.convention: label pixel (i, j) depicts canvas position (i + dy, j + dx)

canvas_offset_evidence.note: bootstrapped from zero in the 2026-09-21 batch; lands in the (-20, -20) family every 0139 and 1667 entry sits in

validity_decision.review_method: realigned against the independent ink prediction, then the labels and the prediction compared in Neuroglancer
validity_decision.note: 639 of the 107467 seam-filled pixels carry a label (0.05% of the annotation), so the extrapolation is in empty margin. After the (-18.5, -25.0) ink alignment the labels agree with the prediction at the corpus median (Dice 0.832, recall 0.841).
